verdict.rationale: The pack confirms that official AWS SDKs exist: AWS states it models its APIs in Smithy to ship daily releases of the AWS SDKs and CLIs, and the botocore data files show SDK service models. AWS also offers the CDK, an official open-source framework in six languages, though it is for infrastructure code rather than general API calls. Missing for 10: first-party SDK documentation (supported languages, install and usage guides for the service SDKs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: At AWS, we use Smithy extensively to model our service APIs and provide the daily releases of the AWS SDKs and CLIs
The AWS CDK supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, C#/.Net, and Go.
The AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) is an open-source software development framework for defining cloud infrastructure in code
